passages.text:
Clearance headed your way on the MDM (misinformation/disinformation/malinformation) IPC process. Just wanted to flag
that I'd be keen to stay really engaged on it, either repping DDI or in tandem with you (whichever you prefer). So crucial
to the larger DRG effort, and an area in which I'm generally hoping USAID can provide a lot of the intellectual firepower.
.- Forwarded message -

Sounds great. I am happy for you to take/keep the lead. By the way, if something needs to get to me to clear, I greatly
appreciate these sort of informal head's up emails. We also have a more formal system, with a tracker that is maintained
by the DDI front office admin. management staff. They can be reached via the collective email
"[contact omitted]"
N.B. The good news is that almost every USAID office or bureau has a similar official tracking system with collective
email addresses. The not so good news is that there is no uniform protocol or naming system, so each corresponding
collective email box has a different name: "[contact omitted]" "[contact omitted]" and
"[contact omitted]" for the Agency's Executive Secretariat., just to name a few. Sigh.
Karl Fickenscher (he/him)

Bureau for Development, Democracy and Innovation (DDI)
